prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art character animation sheet for Agent Office.
Input image: the existing character activity sheet is a STYLE AND IDENTITY REFERENCE. Preserve exactly the six identities, their clothing, palette, head proportions, navy outlines and readable faces. Create a NEW supplementary sheet, not a replacement for existing artwork.
Output: one 1536 by 1024 transparent PNG, exact grid of 6 ROWS and 12 COLUMNS, all 72 complete full-body sprites. No background, glow, shadows outside feet, scenery, floor, desks, labels, separators, text or watermark. Every cell is 128 by about 170 pixels with generous fully transparent gutters between all characters and rows; no sprite touches another. All figures face front. Each row uses one identical character at one shared scale and stable bottom-center feet.
Rows in order: 1 brown-haired male navy jacket, light blue tie; 2 copper ponytail woman turquoise jacket, navy overalls; 3 indigo-haired glasses worker navy suit purple tie; 4 blond worker bright blue hoodie; 5 cream/navy studio robot cyan eyes and small cyan antenna; 6 brown-skinned courier red cap and red jacket.
Columns 1-4: quiet idle loop, relaxed empty hands at sides, small blink and breathing motion; frame 1 open eyes, frame 2 subtle rise, frame 3 blink, frame 4 relaxed open eyes. No books, keyboards or items.
Columns 5-8: cheerful successful-work loop, small alternating raised-arm wave, smile, feet always grounded; no jumping, confetti or attached icons.
Columns 9-12: calm concerned error loop, small head tilt and hand-to-chin/checking gesture, readable serious face, grounded feet. No anger, tears, symbols, red crosses or explosions.
Strict pixel-art clusters matching the reference, limited warm cozy palette, crisp outlines. Consistent identity, facing, costume and silhouette across each row. Meaningful but restrained pose differences; loops must read at native 32 by 36 pixels. Transparent background with real alpha. Create all frames together.
